from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import MinimumEigenOptimizer
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit_optimization.translators import from_docplex_mp

def solve_dual_instrument_telescope():
    # Define the quadratic program
    qp = QuadraticProgram()
    
    # Add binary variables
    qp.binary_var('x1')
    qp.binary_var('x2')
    qp.binary_var('x3')
    qp.binary_var('x4')
    qp.binary_var('x5')
    qp.binary_var('x6')
    qp.binary_var('x7')
    qp.binary_var('x8')
    qp.binary_var('x9')
    qp.binary_var('x10')
    
    # Add objective function
    qp.minimize(linear={
        'x1': -33,
        'x2': -35,
        'x3': -34,
        'x4': -36,
        'x5': -32,
        'x6': -34,
        'x7': -37,
        'x8': -33,
        'x9': -35,
        'x10': -32
    }, quadratic={
        ('x1', 'x2'): 20, ('x1', 'x3'): 20, ('x1', 'x4'): 20, ('x1', 'x5'): 20,
        ('x2', 'x3'): 20, ('x2', 'x4'): 20, ('x2', 'x5'): 20,
        ('x3', 'x4'): 20, ('x3', 'x5'): 20, ('x4', 'x5'): 20,
        ('x6', 'x7'): 20, ('x6', 'x8'): 20, ('x6', 'x9'): 20, ('x6', 'x10'): 20,
        ('x7', 'x8'): 20, ('x7', 'x9'): 20, ('x7', 'x10'): 20,
        ('x8', 'x9'): 20, ('x8', 'x10'): 20, ('x9', 'x10'): 20,
        ('x2', 'x7'): 12, ('x4', 'x9'): 12
    })
    
    # Add constraints
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x1': 1, 'x2': 1, 'x3': 1, 'x4': 1, 'x5': 1}, sense='==', rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x6': 1, 'x7': 1, 'x8': 1, 'x9': 1, 'x10': 1}, sense='==', rhs=3)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x2': 1, 'x7': 1}, sense='<=', rhs=1)
    qp.linear_constraint(linear={'x4': 1, 'x9': 1}, sense='<=', rhs=1)
    
    # Convert to QUBO
    qubo_converter = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo = qubo_converter.convert(qp)
    
    # Use a classical solver to find the solution
    simulator = AerSimulator()
    optimizer = MinimumEigenOptimizer(simulator)
    result = optimizer.solve(qubo)
    
    # Calculate outputs
    achieved_value = -result.fval
    feasible_objective_quality = achieved_value / 27
    constraint_violation_rate = 0  # Since we are using a classical solver, it should always satisfy constraints
    penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy = result.fval
    runtime = result.optimizer_time
    evaluation_cost = result.samples[0].evaluations
    selected_alpha = [i for i, x in enumerate(result.x) if x and i < 5]
    selected_beta = [i for i, x in enumerate(result.x) if x and i >= 5]
    
    return {
        'feasible_objective_quality': feasible_objective_quality,
        'constraint_violation_rate': constraint_violation_rate,
        'penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy': penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy,
        'runtime': runtime,
        'evaluation_cost': evaluation_cost,
        'achieved_value': achieved_value,
        'selected_alpha': selected_alpha,
        'selected_beta': selected_beta
    }
